definitions.explanation: Doing something from a distance, especially work or meetings conducted online rather than in person.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}はリモートで{仕事|しごと}をします。
リモート{会議|かいぎ}に{参加|さんか}してください。
リモートワークが{普及|ふきゅう}しました。

notes: A loanword from English that became especially common after 2020. Often used as a prefix: リモートワーク (remote work), リモート{会議|かいぎ} (remote meeting), リモート{勤務|きんむ} (remote work). Sometimes shortened to リモ.
